Rules.InvariantScript:
Set(getStatus, If( Trim(First( [@PowerBIIntegration].Data).Role) = "Scientific Reviewer", "Awaiting Scientific Review", "Awaiting Medical Review"));




ClearCollect(
        Getdata,
        ShowColumns(
           
                vs_review_workflow_data
               // Status = getStatus
            ,
            Role,
            Status,
            data_management_query,
            medical_query,
            medical_reviewer_comment,
            non_query_action,
            participant_id,
            project_code,
            record_id,
            scientific_reviewer_comment,
            visit_date
        )
    );
If(First([@PowerBIIntegration].Data).Role = "Scientific Reviewer", "Logged in as Scientific Reviewer", "Logged in as Medical Reviewer")
If(First([@PowerBIIntegration].Data).Role = "Scientific Reviewer", "Enter scientific reviewer comment to update in bulk","Scientific Reviewer Comment")

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString: If( IsBlank( LookUp(Getdata, record_id = First([@PowerBIIntegration].Data).record_id)), "", LookUp(Getdata, record_id = First([@PowerBIIntegration].Data).record_id).scientific_reviewer_comment)

Rules.InvariantScript: If(First([@PowerBIIntegration].Data).Role = "Medical Reviewer","Enter medical reviewer comment to update in bulk","Medical Reviewer Comment")

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString: If( IsBlank( LookUp(Getdata, record_id = First([@PowerBIIntegration].Data).record_id)), "", LookUp(Getdata, record_id = First([@PowerBIIntegration].Data).record_id).scientific_reviewer_comment)
"All selected records will be updated." & Char(10) & "If no records are selected, all records currently shown in the report will be updated."

Rules.InvariantScript: "All selected records will be updated." & Char(10) & "If no records are selected, all records currently shown in the report will be updated."

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
Patch(
    vs_review_workflow_data,
    LookUp(
        vs_review_workflow_data,
        record_id = First([@PowerBIIntegration].Data).record_id
    ),
    {
        Status: "Review Completed",
        medical_review_modified_by: User().FullName,
        medical_review_modified_on: Now(),
        scientific_reviewer_comment: txt_sci_reviewer.Text,
        medical_reviewer_comment: txt_med_reviewer.Text,
        medical_query: txt_medical_q.Text,
        data_management_query: txt_data_mgnt_q.Text,
        non_query_action: txt_Non_q.Text,
        record_id: First([@PowerBIIntegration].Data).record_id,
        project_code: Value(txt_project_id.Text),
        participant_id: txt_participant_id.Text,
        visit_date: DateValue(txt_visit_date.Text),
        Role: First([@PowerBIIntegration].Data).Role
    }
);
Patch(
    vs_review_workflow_data_audit,
    Defaults(vs_review_workflow_data_audit),
    {
        visit_date: DateValue(
            Trim(txt_visit_date.Text),
            "en-GB"
        ),
        data_management_query: txt_data_mgnt_q.Text,
        scientific_reviewer_comment: txt_sci_reviewer.Text,
        medical_query: txt_medical_q.Text,
        medical_reviewer_comment: txt_med_reviewer.Text,
        medical_review_modified_by: User().FullName,
        medical_review_modified_on: Now(),
        non_query_action: txt_Non_q.Text,
        participant_id: txt_participant_id.Text,
        project_code: Value(txt_project_id.Text),
        record_id: First([@PowerBIIntegration].Data).record_id,
        Role: First([@PowerBIIntegration].Data).Role,
        Status: "Review Completed"
    }
);
Collect(
    Getdata,
    ShowColumns(
        Filter(
            vs_review_workflow_data,
            Status = "Awaiting Medical Review"
        ),
        Role,
        data_management_query,
        medical_query,
        medical_reviewer_comment,
        non_query_action,
        participant_id,
        project_code,
        record_id,
        scientific_reviewer_comment,
        visit_date
    )
);
Notify(
    "Review Completed!",
    NotificationType.Success
)
